Let \(x\) be the number of female officers on duty.  
Then male officers on duty \(=\frac{4}{3}x\).

\[
x+\frac{4}{3}x=275 \implies \frac{7}{3}x=275 \implies x=\frac{825}{7}
\]

Since \(27\%\) of total female officers \(F\) were on duty:

\[
0.27F=\frac{825}{7}
\]

\[
F=\frac{825/7}{0.27}=\frac{825}{7}\cdot \frac{100}{27}=\frac{27500}{63}
\]

This is not a whole number, so the problem data are inconsistent.

\[
\boxed{\frac{27500}{63}}
\]
